title: Linked Membership Requirement for Northgate Credit Cards
content:
Northgate member services desk guidance on the tie between a Northgate Credit Cards account and the Northgate membership it is linked to.

## Rule

A card works at Northgate only while its linked membership's status is one of the statuses in which the card product works at Northgate. When the linked membership expires, is suspended, cancelled or closed the card is restricted: it keeps working elsewhere on its network but not at Northgate, and its certificate is held. The restriction is lifted when the linked membership is active again. A card is relinked only to another membership of the cardholder whose status is active and whose segment matches the card's required membership segment. A card left restricted for the card product's restriction period, counted in calendar days, is closed by the bank.

## Linked membership status and the card

| What happens to the linked membership | Card account status | At Northgate | Elsewhere on its network | Certificate |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Expires, is suspended, is cancelled or is closed | Becomes restricted | Does not work | Keeps working | Held |
| Becomes active again | Restriction lifted; active | Works | Works | No longer held |

## Relinking a card to another membership

A card is relinked only where every one of these holds, as the membership records show them before the relink:

1. The other membership belongs to the cardholder.
2. Its status is active.
3. Its segment matches the card's required membership segment — a consumer card to a consumer membership, a business card to a business membership.

A relink changes the card's linked membership to the newly linked one. A restricted card that is relinked to an active membership has its restriction lifted.

## Closure after a long restriction

The restriction period is counted in calendar days from the restriction, every day counting. A card left restricted for that many calendar days is closed by Meridian Trust Bank; the closure is the bank's.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical members)

- A cardholder's consumer membership expired last week. The card is restricted: it does not work at a Northgate register but still works elsewhere on its network, and its certificate is held.
- The cardholder renews and the membership is active again. The restriction is lifted.
- A cardholder with a restricted consumer card asks to link it to their business membership, which is active. The segments do not match, so the card is not relinked to it.
- A cardholder asks to link the card to their spouse's membership. It is not the cardholder's membership, so the card is not relinked to it.
